text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio fractures a bone once again. 
She is diagnosed as unable to make it in 
time for the Tenno Sho (Autumn) that they 
had promised each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore... even if she could return in 
the future, her legs had fundamentally 
weakened, leaving little chance of running 
as she once did.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Tokai Teio had not given up. 
Since Yamanin Zephyr kept moving forward, 
she wanted to move forward too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she couldn't keep her promise to 
compete in the Tenno Sho (Autumn), she 
vowed that she would definitely make a 
comeback. So, she asked to wait for her 
just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—A promise can be made again and again. As 
long as the two of them keep running 
without giving up.
